reviewPurpose: Semantically verify that every field of the canonical OVERVIEW row for TM109 is covered by dft-meta.json and dft-conditions.yaml, and that each derived testCondition field is explained by a source locator.
rule: Read the single OVERVIEW row of Dali_testmode.xlsx (plaintext sha256 896770d29f8ae58852e1031c1e6210c5435e52df38e0f6a0fb8fc1836622c04b) and compare rawIntent with testCondition field by field. A source contradiction is preserved as an open item and reported, never resolved. No value may be inferred, no source substituted, no hash re-bound.

fieldChecks.evidence: testCondition.identity copies OVERVIEW columns Item, Level, Name, Description, Purpose and Unit verbatim for the single row whose Item is TM109.
OVERVIEW column Trim is empty for TM109, so the item is not a trim test.
OVERVIEW column Code1 declares vset[vbat,3,100e-6,0] as the static rail and the Power column names VBAT; the 100e-6 ramp slot makes it a direct power-on.

rawIntent.Notes:
ramp up/down vac1 from 3~5V, 1V/ms
mux A2D_VAC2_PRST to dtest0
check int pin toggle

fieldChecks.evidence: OVERVIEW column Code2 contains vset[vac2,10,1e-3,0] and vset[vac2,0,1e-3,0] with the 1e-3 ramp slot, and the Notes column states ramp up/down vac1 from 3~5V, 1V/ms, so hasRamp is true.
testCondition.ramps carries one ordered vac2 sweep copied from OVERVIEW column Code2 in source order; no value is added or inferred.
OVERVIEW column Dynamic reads VAC2 for TM109, so testCondition.dynamicPins contains exactly VAC2.
